# acme-items

Generated Python client for **Acme Items API** (1.2.3), talking to `https://api.acme.test`.

```bash
pip install acme-items
```

```python
from acme_items import Client

with Client() as client:
    result = client.create_item(...)
```

An `AsyncClient` with the same methods is importable alongside `Client`. Errors raise subclasses of `ApiError`; rate limits retry automatically, honoring `Retry-After`.

## Methods

- `create_item` — `POST /v1/items`: Create an item.
- `delete_item` — `DELETE /v1/items/{id}`: Delete an item.
- `get_item` — `GET /v1/items/{id}`: Get one item.
- `get_stats` — `GET /v1/stats`: Get stats.
- `list_items` — `GET /v1/items`: List items.
